About

I'm a Research Fellow at the Supervised Program for Alignment Research and an Undergraduate Researcher at the Governance and Responsible AI Lab (GRAIL). I'm pursuing a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence with a minor in Mathematics at Purdue University.

My research spans mechanistic interpretability, diffusion language models, AI safety, and technical AI governance. Recent work examines policy auditing with internal model evidence, SAE feature evolution during denoising, and behaviour in multi-agent systems.

InterestsMechanistic interpretabilityDiffusion language modelsAI safetyTechnical AI governance

AI Village × Grove Research AI Swarm Dynamics Hackathon · Oct. 2026

Ethogram

An evidence-linked behaviour catalogue and interactive atlas for multi-agent logs. Tracks how behaviours change and spread across AI agents, with every claim linked to the events behind it.

Code ↗

AI Incident Response Hackathon · Apart Research · Sep. 2026

Margin Arena

A reproducible environment for studying AI agents under token, time, verification, tool-call, and session limits. Connects external tasks with inspectable model records.

Code ↗

AI Control Hackathon · Apart Research / Redwood Research · Mar. 2026

DLM-Control

SAE-based monitoring and steering for diffusion language models. Trajectory monitoring detects attacks at a mean denoising step of 9.60, compared with 63.00 for output-only checks on the main benchmark.
